llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam website characteristics: offering a suspiciously wide range of high-demand products (electronics, luxury goods) at steeply discounted prices well below market value; lacking legitimate, accessible company information, contact details, and legal notices; being built on a newly registered and privacy-protected .top TLD; and using static text for legal/privacy and contact information with no real navigation. The overall style, product assortment, and technical choices closely match patterns seen repeatedly in fake online shopping scams.
